name: Banana Streak Virus
description: A viral disease that causes yellow or golden streaks on banana leaves. BSV is integrated into the genome of some banana varieties and can activate under stress. It reduces plant vigor and fruit yield.
symptoms: Yellow or golden chlorotic streaks parallel to leaf veins
Streaks turning brown or necrotic with age
Leaf distortion and reduced leaf area
Stunted plant growth and reduced bunch weight
Pseudostem cracking and splitting in some cases
causes: Virus integrated in host genome can activate spontaneously
treatments: Remove and destroy infected plants showing severe symptoms
Improve growing conditions to reduce plant stress
Control mealybug vectors with appropriate insecticides
prevention: Use virus-indexed tissue culture planting material
Field inspection and removal of infected plants
